$comment: T520 / T673: ONE fixture for the two readers of a range — Python `pipeline.regs.inseason.resolve.touched` (+ `lakes`: every `Release.lake_pieces`) and TS `@app/core` `inSeasonCover`. Both tests read it (pipeline/tests/test_inseason_publish.py, core inseason.test.ts) and must give `expect` for each case. THE RULE (T673): a section whose line [from, to) on the range's stream OVERLAPS [m0, m1) is covered (wholly or partly inside); a section of no length when its start lies in the range; `to` 4294967295 (`lines.OPEN`) is a stream's one section, to its end. A section with `line: null` is a lake piece (no line): `lakes: true` covers every one.

cases.name: a section starting exactly at m1 is out
a section ending exactly at m0 is out
a range ending inside a section touches it
a range starting inside a section touches it
a range inside one section touches only it
a section of no length by its start
an open-ended section (a stream's one section)
lakes: every lake piece of the water
